verdict.rationale: Luma's own materials say its browser workspace includes Luma Agents that handle multi-step video and image workflows, and that these agents research, generate and refine across media types. This is a direct, built-in delegation capability, but the evidence is only short marketing lines with no detail on how tasks are handed off or performed. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how users assign tasks to the agents and what those agents can do autonomously, detail on scope and limits of agent actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
